description: x402 Listing Check: Check an x402 endpoint before paying it: fetch any x402 URL, read its 402 challenge, verify accepts[] is complete (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo), flag placeholder input examples, and measure the challenge against the 8,190 B edge line limit. Answers "is this endpoint payable by a default x402 client?" and returns READY / NEEDS_FIX / NOT_X402 / UNREACHABLE with a fix per finding. Use before listing a new API, or when a buyer says your endpoint does not work.
name: x402-listing-check
